svg.title: Ledger
svg.desc: - 2026-10-13: CI green on GitHub's macOS runner after fixes found there (older-compiler type-check limit, cookie listing on a fresh machine, a smoke test assuming port 9 is closed). Open: LifecycleTests.test_five_concurrent_clients (five simultaneous first opens) timed out on the runner in 2 of 6 runs, before and after a load watchdog; never locally (8/8 at load average 67). The test now records whether the daemon still answers and samples its main thread when it happens.
